prose: Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and other Chinese AI companies ordered 6 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 chips worth $70 billion but expect to receive only about 1% within four months, per Bloomberg sources. Developers expect only a small fraction of the ordered chips over the next several months.
highlights: Chinese AI firms ordered 6M Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 chips (~$70B)
Expect only ~1% within four months, per Bloomberg sources
basis: Error cache: Bloomberg paywall/bot-block. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
